# Global Conventions

Conventions that apply across the entire repo, regardless of language or directory.

Prefer retrieval-led reasoning over pre-training-led reasoning. When a row's convention applies to your edit, read the referenced body before making the change.

How to add a new convention: use the `add-convention` skill.

<!-- BEGIN_TABLE: generated by scripts/generate-conventions-index.py, edits inside will be overwritten -->

| Convention | File |
| --- | --- |
| When review feedback corrects A to B, rewrite directly to B instead of adding unnecessary negative wording about not-A. | [avoid-oppositional-negative-rewrites](../conventions/global/avoid-oppositional-negative-rewrites.md) |
| Write source-code comments and docstrings in English — applies to module/class/function docstrings and inline comments across every language. | [comments-and-docstrings-in-english](../conventions/global/comments-and-docstrings-in-english.md) |
| Decode JSON into an operation- or domain-specific typed payload at ingress instead of using raw JSON primitive unions in business logic. | [decode-json-into-typed-payloads](../conventions/global/decode-json-into-typed-payloads.md) |
| Update dependencies through package-manager lock resolution and parent dependency upgrades; never add overrides unless the requester explicitly requires one. | [dependency-updates-without-overrides](../conventions/global/dependency-updates-without-overrides.md) |
| In tests, use explicit synchronization or authoritative state instead of fixed sleeps or scheduler yields to establish ordering; reserve wall-clock waits for behavior whose contract is elapsed time. | [deterministic-test-synchronization](../conventions/global/deterministic-test-synchronization.md) |
| Use Mermaid only when a non-trivial graph materially improves comprehension; keep compact chains, stacks, trees, and literal shapes in clearer text forms. | [diagrams-in-mermaid](../conventions/global/diagrams-in-mermaid.md) |
| In patch/partial-update APIs, treat explicit `null` as "set this field to null" — use field omission for "leave unchanged" and separate actions for clearing overrides. | [patch-null-means-set-null](../conventions/global/patch-null-means-set-null.md) |
| Use supported external-service SDK public APIs instead of hand-written provider calls; exceptions require requester approval. | [prefer-supported-external-service-sdks](../conventions/global/prefer-supported-external-service-sdks.md) |
| Treat Redis as optional: provide an equivalent non-Redis implementation and never depend on Redis availability, persistence, or HA for correctness. | [redis-optional-no-ha](../conventions/global/redis-optional-no-ha.md) |
| Derive Agent Workspace paths only from current Runner-reported Runtime evidence — never from fixed absolute paths, server HOME, or Provider mount configuration. | [runner-reported-agent-workspace](../conventions/global/runner-reported-agent-workspace.md) |
| Use `scripts/rebase-stacked-prs.sh` when rebasing stacked PR branches together so the process stops cleanly at the first conflict. | [stacked-pr-rebase-script](../conventions/global/stacked-pr-rebase-script.md) |
| All log lines, error messages, API response messages, and WebSocket text returned to users or operators must be in English — this is a global service whose users do not read Korean. | [user-facing-text-in-english](../conventions/global/user-facing-text-in-english.md) |
| In bare-cache worktrees, refresh origin/main with an explicit refspec before rebasing onto main — `git fetch origin main` alone may leave origin/main stale. | [worktree-rebase-origin-main](../conventions/global/worktree-rebase-origin-main.md) |

<!-- END_TABLE -->
